config..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "gc-ai",
  "displayName": "GC AI",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Work in your GC AI legal knowledge base from Claude: upload documents, run review playbooks, and ask questions grounded in your own files, all as you.",
  "author": {
    "name": "GC AI",
    "email": "support@gc.ai",
    "url": "https://gc.ai"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/GC-AI-Inc/gc-ai-claude-plugin",
  "repository": "https://github.com/GC-AI-Inc/gc-ai-claude-plugin",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": ["legal", "contracts", "document-review", "playbooks", "gc-ai"]
}

markdown_frontmatter.agents/gc-ai-analyst.md:
name: gc-ai-analyst
description: Autonomously runs a complete GC AI legal task end to end (upload documents, run a review playbook, or ask grounded questions) and reports back with cited findings. Use to delegate a full document-review or research workflow to GC AI, especially in Cowork or background runs.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/ask/SKILL.md:
name: ask
description: Ask a legal question grounded in the user's GC AI knowledge base, optionally against specific documents. Use for legal research, summarization, or Q&A over the user's own files, playbooks, and skills rather than the model's general knowledge.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/organize-matter/SKILL.md:
name: organize-matter
description: Group documents into a GC AI project (matter) so later review and questions are scoped to it. Use when the user is starting a new matter, deal, or case, or wants a set of files kept and worked on together.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/review-document/SKILL.md:
name: review-document
description: Review one or more documents against a GC AI playbook and summarize the findings. Use when the user wants a contract or document checked, redlined, or run through a review playbook in their GC AI knowledge base.
